QUOTE: `check_approval` consults only the allow list. The deny list is checked later, in `ServerManager::execute`. ... approved = loop.auto_approve_tools OR server_manager.is_explicitly_allowed(allow list)

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer says the allow list feeds into approval via `ToolExecutor::check_approval`. It never says the allow list suppresses the approval step rather than granting execution. It also doesn't say the allow list is consulted only from `check_approval`, which lives in a different file.
